title: PixelKin - Tallow Lift (sting)
_note: The Tallow Lift ride (09-the-wild-ways §2A): the wax-carters' cable car hauling up/down the dark mountain's west flank. A short, gentle one-shot over the travel fade: a creak of cable (short falling noise glides), a rising pluck arpeggio (the car climbing), a warm strings bed and a bell at the top. G major, 104 BPM, 2 bars = ~4.6 s + a 1.2 s ring-out (render --tail 1.2). Ends on the tonic. Classic-only (no remaster), played via the musicSting op like sting-hour. Original (VISION.md).
